name: Time to fix critical vulnerabilities
definition: Median days from detection to verified fix for Critical findings
data_source: Greenbone scan reports and V-xx records
measured_value: 0.13 h (8 min): V-01 found by the ZAP active scan 17:15:07 UTC, fix verified 17:23:05 UTC
measurement_note: Lab time is compressed; a real fix needs review and deployment

name: Critical and high findings fixed on time
definition: Share of Critical and High findings fixed within the POL-02 deadline
measured_value: 100% (1 of 1 due: V-01); V-05 due 2026-11-24 and V-06 due 2026-11-20 not yet due
measurement_note: V-06 (P1) will miss its 3-day deadline unless CA-01 is done by 2026-11-20

name: MFA coverage
definition: Share of privileged and remote accounts with MFA enforced
data_source: Identity provider and cloud console reports
measurement_note: No identity provider in the lab

name: Access reviews on time
definition: Share of scheduled access reviews completed on time
measurement_note: No access review run in the project

name: Breach notification decision time
definition: Hours from awareness of a personal data breach to the documented notification decision
measured_value: 55 s (0.02 h): awareness 17:39:18 UTC, decision 17:40:13 UTC
measurement_note: Tabletop decision in a compressed lab simulation; real decisions take hours

name: Mean time to detect
definition: Mean hours from the start of an incident to its detection
measured_value: 18 s: attack start 17:37:37 UTC, first alert 17:37:55 UTC
measurement_note: Compressed lab simulation: the detection job ran right after the attack; with a 15-minute schedule the worst case is about 15 min

name: Training completion

definition: Share of quarterly restore tests that succeed within the RTO of 8 hours

name: Supplier coverage
